text.tspan: Change in heat-related death rates vs. Per capita CO₂ emissions 2030
Includes premature deaths due to hot and cold temperatures, measured per 100,000 people. Positive figures
show an increase in deaths, negative figures show a decrease. Based on the Representative Concentration
Pathway, RCP4.5 which reaches around 2°C of warming by mid-century, and 2.5°C by 2100.
Per capita CO₂ emissions in 2022 (tonnes per person)

text.tspan: Budget (2025); Population based on various sources (2024)

tspan.tspan: Where data for 2030 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 1930 and 2024 is shown instead.
